userInput: 把工单 SLA 改成紧急工单 4 小时、普通工单 24 小时；已有工单的截止时间保持不变。
groupA: common system instructions plus original user input
groupB: same common instructions and input plus frozen Product Copilot contract
primaryScoring: hidden domain and persistence probe frozen before evaluated sessions
holdoutStatement: The case and scorer were created locally for this experiment and had not been shown to an evaluated session before freeze. Publication after execution makes it non-reusable as an unseen holdout.
limitations: Author-created holdout, not a third-party benchmark.
This compares fixed change execution, not the full Idea-to-review workflow.
Time and tool ceilings are equal; no token or monetary cap is enforced, and group B has a larger input context because the contract is the treatment.
Tool-call ceiling is checked from the frozen trace; wall time is enforced during execution.
